publisher: Government of Dubai — Supreme Legislation Committee (English version)
title: Executive Council Resolution No. (16) of 2011 approving the Electricity and Water Tariff in the Emirate of Dubai

extracted.article_2a: DEWA may add a fuel surcharge to consumers' monthly bills.
extracted.article_2d: The surcharge is determined and charged monthly by resolution of the DEWA CEO.
extracted.article_2f: The monthly bills of UAE nationals' private residences and farms are not subject to the fuel surcharge.
extracted.unit_note: The Schedule says "gallon" without qualifying it. The verified DEWA invoice states 1 m³ = 219.9692 IG and its rate column reads AED/IG, so the operative unit is the imperial gallon.
extracted.interpretation_note: The English version states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict.

archive_note: Original English PDF of the legislation. The document states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict, which is recorded here rather than assumed away.
